info.name: Sendent
info.summary: Secure emails and share files through Nextcloud, while keeping Outlook, Apple Mail, Thunderbird, and Microsoft Teams.
info.description:
Sendent connects Outlook, Apple Mail, Thunderbird, and Microsoft Teams to Nextcloud. Files and secure messages stay on infrastructure your organization controls. Keep familiar tools, while Nextcloud becomes your controlled data layer. Stay hybrid or transition fully; no all-at-once migration is required.
**Nextcloud for Email Suite (Outlook, Apple Mail, and Thunderbird)**
Keep your email clients. Share files through Nextcloud. Files can be uploaded and shared from the compose workflow with passwords, expiration dates, and revocable access, depending on the email client:
- Nextcloud for Outlook:
Attachments, Secure Mail and Nextcloud Talk meetings, all from the compose window. Files stay in your own Nextcloud, not OneDrive or SharePoint.
- Nextcloud for Mail (compatible with Apple Mail):
Secure file sharing for Mac users, without switching to Outlook.
- Nextcloud for Thunderbird:
Full-featured sharing and Secure Mail directly from Thunderbird.
**Nextcloud for MS Teams**
Browse, share, and open Nextcloud files without leaving Teams.
- Make Nextcloud the preferred upload destination inside Teams. - Run Nextcloud alongside OneDrive and SharePoint, or replace them entirely. - Files stay under Nextcloud permissions and sharing controls.
Paid customers can manage admin policies centrally from this app. Free users can get started with Nextcloud for Outlook. Nextcloud for Thunderbird and Nextcloud for Mail (compatible with Apple Mail) already work with this app; settings specific to them are not available yet.
